build.description: Bundles the browser app into public/build. Pass --watch to rebuild on change.

serve.description: Builds the browser app, then serves everything on port 8000.
serve.command: deno task build && deno serve -P=serve --env-file --port 8000 main.ts

dev.description: Builds, then serves with server auto-restart on change. Run `deno task build --watch` in a second terminal for client rebuilds.
dev.command: deno task build && deno serve -P=serve --env-file --watch --port 8000 main.ts

check.description: Checks the code for errors, formatting, and runs the linter.
check.command: deno check && deno lint && deno fmt --check
